motto.heading: editorial eye.
motto.text1: My style sits somewhere between editorial and lifestyle — carefully composed, but never overly posed.
motto.text2: I love natural movement, beautiful light, thoughtful styling and real human connection.
motto.text3: The result? Images that feel effortless, personal and distinctly yours.

feedback1.text: I've looked through the pictures three times now, and I can only say again how much I like them. You did a great job, and I even like myself in these photos! Thank you so much for your great work and support.
feedback1.author: Carsten

feedback2.text: I keep going back to the photos — I simply can't stop looking at them. They are so atmospheric, full of mood, and so completely me — my home, my personality, everything. I like myself in these photos so much — how, how did you do that?? And the whole experience was amazing. With you, everything felt so relaxed and natural, with no pressure at all. We were just talking and enjoying the moment, and somehow you were taking photos the whole time. I think that's what makes your work so special — especially for anyone who doesn't like being in front of the camera.
feedback2.author: Natali

feedback3.text: I'm so happy and grateful that you photographed me that day. It was so much more than a photoshoot — it was a whole adventure, full of positive energy and wonderful emotions. You are incredible, and the photos are absolutely stunning. I'm so happy with them!
feedback3.author: Natalia

mottoEnd.heading: Let's create your story together.
mottoEnd.text1: Tell me what you're planning, and we'll taker it from there.

motto.heading: Everyone has a story worth seeing.
motto.text1: Personal Stories are about more than portraits. They capture your character, mood, presence and the little moments that make your story yours.
motto.text2: From intimate portraits to relaxed, cinematic stories — I create images that feel personal, natural and true to you.

mottoEnd.heading: You don't have to know how to pose.
mottoEnd.text1: I'll guide you when needed and leave space for the natural moments in between — the movement, the connection, the little things that make the image feel like you.

motto.heading: The people we love shape our story.
motto.text1: Couples and family stories are about connection — the way you look at each other, move together, laugh, hold on, and simply share a moment.
motto.text2: From quiet, intimate portraits to playful, cinematic moments, I create images that preserve not just how you looked, but how it felt to be together.

mottoEnd.heading: The best photographs are the ones that bring you back to a feeling.
mottoEnd.text1: Let's create something you'll want to return to.

motto.heading: Your brand has a story to tell.
motto.text1: Your business is more than a logo, a product or a service. It's the people behind it, the way you work, the spaces you create, the details, the atmosphere — everything that makes it yours.
motto.text2: I create natural, thoughtful imagery for personal brands, small businesses and creative projects — from portraits and everyday content to campaigns, interiors and visual stories.
motto.text3: Whether you need images for your website, social media, a new launch or simply a stronger visual presence, we'll create photographs that feel authentic to your brand.

motto.heading: Where expression takes the lead.
motto.text1: I photograph artists and performers through character, movement, atmosphere and emotion — creating images that feel as expressive as the work itself.
motto.text2: From theatre and dance to music and performance, I create expressive portraits and visual stories with an editorial eye.

about.heading: i photograph people, not poses
about.text1: I've always been drawn to people — to the way they move, connect, express themselves and simply be present in a moment.
about.text2: For me, photography is about noticing those things: a gesture, a look, a movement, a quiet moment in between. I want my images to feel intentional and beautiful, but never forced.
about.text3: My approach is somewhere between editorial and lifestyle. I bring an editorial eye to the way I work with light, composition, styling and space, while keeping the experience relaxed and natural.
about.text4: I'll guide you throughout the shoot, help with the concept, styling and location when needed — so you don't have to know how to pose or worry about what to do in front of the camera.
about.text5: My background is in design, and it continues to shape the way I see. I notice spaces, light, proportions and details everywhere — and that way of seeing naturally became part of my photography.
about.text6: I'm based in Vienna and work across Europe, photographing people, brands, creatives and the stories that matter to them.
